you_should_know.title: 'We will protect this place forever': Walz announces executive order banning copper, nickel mining near the Boundary Waters
you_should_know.summary: Gov. Tim Walz signed an executive order banning copper and nickel mining near the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis, after Congress voted in April to overturn a 20-year federal ban there. The order landed in the middle of a long-running local argument: Twin Metals says its proposed mine would bring hundreds of union jobs plus 1,400 more positions, while opponents say the risk to the watershed is not worth it, and coverage through the week weighed whether such a mine could ever be run safely.
